goal: Beat the game: kill the Ender Dragon. This replaces any earlier goal about building a town; drop town-building work that does not help. Rough path: get food and iron gear, then diamonds, an enchanting setup if cheap; mine obsidian and build a Nether portal; in the Nether find a fortress and collect blaze rods, and get ender pearls (Endermen, or bartering with piglins for gold); craft eyes of ender (aim for 12 or more), follow them to the stronghold, fill the End portal, and kill the dragon (destroy the end crystals first; bring bows, plenty of arrows, blocks, water bucket, food and beds for your spawn near the portal). Work as a pair: split jobs, share gear, keep the shared plan current with the next milestone, and re-equip whoever dies. Do not take needless risks while under-geared. Leadership: Clade is the leader, sets the plan and priorities; GPT follows it and can propose ideas.
